propositions: Extract bridge orchestration logic into a runner-neutral packaged Python core (rebar.bridge_run) and expose through Python library, CLI (rebar bridge run --profile), and MCP interfaces.
Support five profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) that map to existing rebar commands while preserving legacy MODE environment variable compatibility.
Ensure the packaged runner is deliverable and functional from all supported install paths: pip wheel, Homebrew wheel-backed environment, and MCP Registry/uvx.
Thin GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab CI wrappers to invoke only the installed CLI entrypoint (rebar bridge run) rather than repository-local scripts.
Preserve direct legacy reconcile caller behavior (benign results 3/4/75) while translating benign results to canonical 0 for new provider-runner callers.
